tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'i sdom bzhugs// maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab/ /lhar bskyed gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ /smad g.yogs stod g.yogs gtsug tor sbyin/ /gdong bcings me tog phreng ba gtad/ /sgo bzhi phyag dang rgyun bshags bya/ /gsol gdab slob ma slob dpon gnyis/ /dris lan dam tshig bsgrags sdom bzung / /nang gi sems bskyed gsang bar gdams/ /yol ba'i nang zhugs dam la bzhag /maṇḍal gsol gdab ye shes dbab/ /brtan par byas nas gsol ba gdab/ /kha dog dris lan bden stobs brjod/ /me tog phul la mgo la bcings/ /gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan/ /rnam dag bstan rnams 'jug pa'o/ /slob ma'i dbang phyir maṇḍal phul/ /gsol btab rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur/ /de nas sngags kyi zlas lung bya/ /rdo dril brtul zhugs so sor sbyin/ /slob dpon dbang phyir maṇḍal phul/ /gsol btab dbang stegs bskyed steng bzhag /lhar bskyed go bgo ye shes bstim/ /gsol btab thugs rgyud bzlas pas bskul/ /dbang 'dir yang bum pa dang me tog btegs te bkra shis bya lha spyan drangs chu dbang rgyas/ /cod paṇa dar 'phyang rdo 'phreng sbyin/ /rdo dril ming gi dbang bskur dang / /phyag rgya'i de nyid rgyas par brjod/ /chu dbang bskur la rgyas gdab ste/ /mchod cing rab gnas rtogs bskyed bya/ /gsang dbang maṇḍal gsol ba btab/ /gdong bcings gsang dbang bdud rtsi sbyin/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol la rtogs bskyed bya/ /sher ye maṇḍal gsol ba gdab/ /gdong bcing dri ba dris lan bya/ /dbang dngos bskur la dga' bzhi bsgoms/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol la rtogs bskyed bya/ /bzhi pa maṇḍal gsol ba gdab/ /gdong bcing bzhi pa ngo sprad de/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol la rtogs bskyed bya/ /rdo dril lha mchod rjes gnang dang / /mig thur me long mda' gzhu dang / /me long gnyis pa chos bshad la/ /'bud dung 'khor lo pu sti dang /

/dril bu rnams ni dus gcig sbyin/ /dam tshig bsgrags rnams rjes gnang ngo / /mtha' rten zhes bya lung bstan dang / /lam gyi dbugs dbyung rdo dril gyi/ /rtul zhugs 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung la/ /gzengs bstod rjes kyi chos gsum mo/ /'di yang dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'i sdom/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
